26:184.text: "And fear Him Who created you and the generations of the men of old."

26:185.text: They said: "You are only one of those bewitched!

26:186.text: "You are but a human being like us and verily, we think that you are one of the liars!

26:187.text: "So cause a piece of the heaven to fall on us, if you are of the truthful!"

26:188.text: He said: "My Lord is the Best Knower of what you do."

26:189.text: But they belied him, so the torment of the day of shadow
seized them. Indeed that was the torment of a Great Day.

26:190.text: Verily, in this is indeed a sign, yet most of them are not believers.

26:191.text: And verily your Lord, He is indeed the All-Mighty, the Most Merciful.

26:192.text: is a revelation from the Lord of the ‘Âlamîn

26:196.text: (the Qur’ân, and its revelation to Prophet Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم)

26:197.text: Is it not a sign to them that the learned scholars
(like ‘Abdullâh bin Salâm رضي الله عنه who embraced Islâm)
of the Children of Israel knew it

26:198.text: And if We had revealed it

26:199.text: And he had recited it unto them, they would not have believed in it.

26:200.text: to enter the hearts of the Mûjrimûn

26:201.text: They will not believe in it until they see the painful torment.

26:202.text: It shall come to them of a sudden, while they perceive it not.

26:203.text: Then they will say: "Can we be respited?"

26:204.text: Would they then wish for Our Torment to be hastened on?

26:205.text: if We do let them enjoy for years,
